_comment: https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11058. `main.js` drops and warns about each ambiguous name: `T` resolves to two different bindings of `ext`, `U` to a binding of `ext` and a declaration, and `N` to the namespaces of `ext` and `ext2`. `S` and `M` resolve to the same binding twice and stay exported. Without ESM output, a namespace import links to the external module's namespace symbol, so the CJS variant checks that `N` still warns.
